native.oc_outcome: Actual application response status, independent successful RPC framing or TLS.
native.oc_soap_phase: Actual SOAP request versus its synchronous HTTP response.

native.oc_security_source: Actual credentials/certificate validation and active security profile, no plaintext secret.
native.oc_connection_id: Actual correlated OCPP connection; opposed directions have separate pending CALLs.

native.oc_station_id: Actual station identity, percent-encoded only in URL; edition-specific character rules.
native.oc_endpoint: Actual configured absolute endpoint, no illustrative hostname or universal TCP port.

native.oc_ping_s: Actual client WebSocket ping interval;0 disables client initiation, not server pong handling.
native.oc_pending_calls: Actual previous outstanding CALLs from same sender on this connection.
native.oc_message_attempts: Actual transaction-related retry count, no example3 promoted to default.

native.oc_backoff_random_s: Actual configured maximum reconnect random portion.
native.oc_backoff_step: Actual reconnect doubling step, capped by configured repeat count.
native.oc_backoff_jitter_s: Actual selected random portion for current retry.

native.oc_message_items: Actual number of items in selected report/message.

native.oc_password_chars: Actual credential length only, edition/profile qualified, secret is not stored here.
native.oc_tls_fragment_bytes: Actual negotiated TLS fragment bound, separate OCPP object or WebSocket size.
native.oc_age_ms: Actual accepted data age, independent ping or HTTP200 success.
native.oc_identity_unique: Actual station identity uniqueness evidence for this CSMS.
native.oc_message_id_unused: Actual ID uniqueness in edition-defined sender/station scope, not random-ID assumption.
native.oc_pending_match: Actual matching pending request/response, not simply equal strings.
native.oc_expects_response: Actual RPC expectation; SEND6 has none.
native.oc_compression_supported: Actual endpoint support of RFC7692, role/version-dependent.
native.oc_compression_negotiated: Actual extension negotiation, not merely support capability.
native.oc_tls: Actual transport encrypted state, not assumed from OCPP itself.
native.oc_basic_auth: Actual Basic-authentication use, distinct TLS peer authentication.
native.oc_client_certificate: Actual selected client-certificate use for mutual TLS.
native.oc_peer_verified: Actual peer chain/hostname/time validation outcome; not guaranteed by TLS version alone.
native.oc_boot_triggered: Actual CSMS exception instruction for a pending station boot retry.
native.oc_call_triggered: Actual pending-station CALL authorized by applicable CSMS trigger/report instruction.
native.oc_data_accepted: Actual functional acceptance outcome, not merely CALLRESULT.
native.oc_queue_all: Actual device offline-queue policy; no automatic unlimited buffer.
